narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed that to `retryCount`. It now takes either shape. See [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6). `isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`. Unset now means off, the old default. See [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 `WARN DEP` lines are hardcoded in [build.js:18](build.js:18). They name files this repo does not have.

Next: nothing.
